In library-reports-view.tsx give the EmptyState an action, e.g. a secondary 'Pilih periode lain' that applies the previous-month preset.

findings.title: Profile avatar changes colour from the header; long name truncated on a phone
findings.description: The same person's avatar is green in the header, and in the profile identity card it is rose (Admin, Satpam), purple (Siswa, Wakil), blue (Kepala Sekolah, Pustakawan) or peach (Guru BK). Two colours for one person on one screen. On a phone the card's h-level name is cut to 'Wakil Kepala Sekolah Con…' even though it is the only thing the card is about and could wrap.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/profile/components/avatar-upload.tsx:80 renders `<Avatar ... size={64}>` without `tone`, so Avatar hashes the name (packages/ui/src/components/avatar.tsx:43-49, 105). The header passes `tone="accent"` (apps/web/components/account-menu.tsx:95-110). The name in apps/web/features/profile/components/profile-identity.tsx:26 uses `truncate`.
findings.fix: Add `tone="accent"` to the Avatar at avatar-upload.tsx:80. At profile-identity.tsx:26 replace `truncate` with `line-clamp-2 [overflow-wrap:anywhere]`.

findings.title: Phone field says 'Belum diisi' while its hint says a saved number is hidden
findings.description: The Telepon field shows the placeholder 'Belum diisi' (not filled), and directly under it the hint reads 'Nomor yang tersimpan tidak ditampilkan; isi untuk menggantinya.' A user with a saved number is told it is empty, and one without is told it is hidden. Neither can tell which applies. The Email field next to it has no placeholder at all.
findings.cause: apps/web/messages/id.json:452 `phonePlaceholder: "Belum diisi"`, used at apps/web/features/profile/components/edit-profile-form.tsx:116. The number is write-only because /me does not expose it (edit-profile-form.tsx:16-17).
findings.fix: Change the placeholder to a neutral instruction such as 'Isi nomor baru' and keep the hint. Once the API returns a masked number (see apiNeeded), show it as the placeholder ('•••• 1234').

findings.title: Phone scanner is a small landscape box in a card, a third of the screen left empty
findings.description: On a 390x844 phone the viewfinder is a 4:3 landscape box of about 320x240 inside a padded card, with its own border, so there are two frames. About 230px of empty background sits between the card and the tab bar. A phone app's scanner reads as a camera screen when the viewfinder is square or taller. The intro paragraph also takes four lines above it.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/scanner-viewfinder.tsx:155 `aspect-[4/3] w-full rounded-lg border border-border` at every width. The action variant sits inside a Card in packages/ui/src/components/scanner.tsx.
findings.fix: Use `aspect-square sm:aspect-[4/3]` (or `aspect-[3/4] max-h-[60dvh]` below sm) at scanner-viewfinder.tsx:155. Drop the inner border when the viewfinder is inside the action Card. Trim the scan intro (apps/web/messages/features/scan.id.json `intro`) to one sentence on a phone.

findings.title: Kiosk header on a phone is a giant clock with no screen name
findings.description: At 390px the kiosk header is 'SC SMA Contoh', a 48px '14.07' wedged between the brand and the close button, and an X. 'Monitor langsung' and the date are both hidden, so the only header text that names anything is the school.
findings.cause: apps/web/components/kiosk-shell.tsx:90 uses `text-kiosk-display` at every width. The title is `hidden ... sm:block` (line 82) and the date `max-sm:hidden` (line 95).
findings.fix: Use `text-title-lg sm:text-kiosk-display` for the clock at kiosk-shell.tsx:90. Below sm, show the screen title under the brand name (`text-caption`) instead of hiding it.

findings.title: Two different 'no access' pages
findings.description: On /monitor a refused reader gets a bare full-screen state: icon, title, one 'Kembali ke beranda' button with a house icon, no back button and no code. On /inbox (siswa) the app's forbidden page has two buttons, 'Kembali ke beranda' and '← Halaman sebelumnya', plus 'Kode 403'. The same state is drawn two ways.
findings.cause: apps/web/app/(kiosk)/kiosk-layout-client.tsx:33-47 builds its own StatePage. apps/web/components/forbidden-page.tsx:20-35 is the app's version.
findings.fix: Give ForbiddenPage (and ModuleUnavailablePage) a `fullScreen` prop that passes through to StatePage, and render them from kiosk-layout-client.tsx instead of the inline StatePage.

findings.title: Report icons repeat, and 'izin tidak masuk' has three icons across the app
findings.description: In the catalogue, 'Poin pelanggaran' and 'Surat peringatan' share the red shield, and 'Pengajuan izin' and 'Izin keluar tahunan' share the door. A leave request (izin tidak masuk) is drawn with the exit-permit door here, an inbox tray on the /inbox tile, and a clipboard on /notifications.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/reports/components/reports-view.tsx:35-40 keys icons on the kind's first segment only. apps/web/features/permits/components/permit-unified-queue.tsx:79 uses `Inbox` for leave. apps/web/features/notifications/components/notifications-view.tsx:59 uses ClipboardList. packages/ui/src/icons.ts:32-53 has no leave or warning-letter icon.

Key the report icons on the full kind ('permits.leave_requests' to leave, 'discipline.warning_letters' to warningLetter). Use domainIcons.leave in permit-unified-queue.tsx and in the notifications KIND_ICON map.

findings.title: Report catalogue on a phone is six tall cards, each with its own 'Unduh' button
findings.description: On a phone the six report cards stack at about 150px each, every one with an outline 'Unduh' button under its description. The page runs about 1300px and only two reports fit the first screen. The desktop grid has been squeezed rather than turned into a phone list. 'Unduh' also opens a form rather than downloading.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/reports/components/reports-view.tsx:112-170 renders the same Card grid at every width.
findings.fix: Below md, render the catalogue as a `List` of `ListRow`s (IconCircle leading, title, description as meta, chevron), each opening the args form in a bottom Sheet. Keep the card grid from md up. Rename the card button 'Pilih' or 'Atur unduhan', since it expands the form.

findings.title: Librarian's all-clear inbox is the only one with no way on
findings.description: Every other role's empty /inbox offers 'Lihat riwayat izin' or 'Lihat surat peringatan'. The librarian's card stops at 'Semua pengajuan dan tugas Anda sudah selesai.' with no action. Its queue is late arrivals, and nothing links to their history.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/inbox/components/action-inbox-view.tsx:20-23. HISTORY_LINKS lists only /leave-requests and /discipline/warning-letters.
findings.fix: Add `{ href: "/late-arrivals", label: "historyLate" }` to HISTORY_LINKS, with 'Lihat riwayat keterlambatan' in apps/web/messages/features/inbox.id.json (and en).

findings.title: Header account name truncated with 450px of free header
findings.description: The desktop header shows 'Wakil Kepala Sekolah C…' beside the avatar, while about 450px of empty header separates it from the search field.
findings.cause: apps/web/components/account-menu.tsx:112-113 caps the name and role at `max-w-40` (160px).
findings.fix: Raise the cap to `max-w-56` (or `lg:max-w-64`). The header has room from lg up.

baseline.note: /notifications, /profile and /scan are on the 720px narrow template, centred; /inbox and /reports on the 1200px default. No page stretches its rows edge to edge any more.

/notifications now uses a SegmentedControl (radio semantics, no panels). On /reports the section strip is still a Tabs whose inactive triggers point at panels that are never rendered (reports-workspace-view.tsx:95), so the axe aria-controls violation should remain there.

The list is now the shared Card, List and ListRow, with kind icons in soft circles, chevrons and a SearchInput. Each row still repeats the full date under the day heading, and on a phone that date now truncates the titles to 'Pen…', which is a regression (finding home-personal-2-01). The bell panel still draws its own row variant.
One identity card (64px avatar shown once) and Akun, Data diri and Keamanan tabs. The grid holes, the duplicate avatar and the three save buttons are gone (save is a rising bar).
Profile, reports, notifications and inbox all use the shared Card at the same large radius. No 8px boxes remain on these routes.

The Data diri tab was not captured. The code (edit-detail-form.tsx) shows Select for religion and blood type, DatePicker, and a read-only DataList for NIS, NIP and employment, with employment status translated, so it looks resolved.
The camera now opens first, in a framed viewfinder with a hint. Manual entry is a quiet link under it. Kiosk-size controls are gone.
The denied camera state was not captured. The shared Scanner now has a pre-permission and denied status (scanner.tsx:191) and its own close control with i18n labels.
/monitor is in its own KioskShell (brand, large clock, date, no sidebar or tab bar). The wall display behind the token was not captured, so its type sizes could not be judged.

The gate no longer shows the config key ('Token tampilan didapat dari admin sekolah.') and sits in the kiosk frame, not under the Piket nav. The admin is still sent to 'the admin' with no place to find the token (see apiNeeded).
The h1 and description come first, then an underline section strip, then the pill 'Unduhan / Jadwal kirim'. Two clearly different levels. On a phone the strip scrolls with a fade instead of wrapping.

Multi-section readers keep one header across sections. Single-section readers still get a different page per role: 'Laporan perpustakaan' with a primary 'Ekspor XLSX', 'Rekap kunjungan' with a secondary 'Unduh rekap', and 'Laporan' with 'Unduh' cards (finding home-personal-2-06).
All-clear states now offer a history link, except the librarian's (finding home-personal-2-15). The section heading uses SectionHeader with a count badge.
The accordion became an icon card grid, but the description still says 'sebagai berkas Excel' while PDF is offered (finding home-personal-2-06).

apiNeeded: Monitor: let GET /v1/monitor/snapshot and /ws/monitor accept the signed-in session that holds view_monitor_presence, so an admin skips the token gate, or add an admin endpoint that reveals or rotates monitor.display_token so the gate can link to it.
Profile: return a masked phone number in /v1/me (or the profile endpoint) so the Telepon field can show the stored number instead of the 'Belum diisi' placeholder.

reviews.verdict: Kesiswaan now looks like one product. Every page in this unit sits on the AppPage template: one h1 with an eyebrow, area tabs and the shared DataTable toolbar. On a phone, forms open as bottom sheets with a sticky Batal/Simpan footer, and the dark violations screens hold up with no glare and no light panels. /duty is the best screen: the QR comes first and large, with a countdown ring, and the late queue and desk log sit beside it. What lets the area down is finish. Empty lists show two identical primary buttons, and BK gets three on the phone. The early-warning level tiles shrink to 80px squares at the left of an empty row. The SP meter's legend sits one tick off its markers. The club detail page still looks pre-overhaul, with an inline form and raw ISO dates. On a phone, Pelanggaran stacks three sideways scrollers before any content, and /duty hides its fourth mode completely.
best: /duty on desktop: the QR comes first and large with a countdown ring, and the late queue and desk log sit beside it. It is a real 'Piket hari ini' screen, and the raw token is gone.
Forms open as bottom sheets on the phone with a drag handle and a sticky Batal/Simpan footer: counseling, prestasi, kegiatan and ekstrakurikuler.
/discipline/violations in dark mode: the primary button uses the bright accent, the tabs and pills stay legible, and no light panel is left behind.
/discipline/students/[studentId] header: avatar, NIS, profile link and three ranked actions. On the phone the secondary actions fold into the overflow menu.
List pages share one toolbar (search, filter pills, density and column icons) and one framed empty state, so the pages read as siblings.
worst: /activities/clubs/[clubId]: an inline add form above the list, raw ISO join dates, a bare search input, and 'Keluarkan' ends a membership in one tap.
/analytics: the three level tiles shrink to 80px squares at the left of a row about 1150px wide, with chevrons crammed against their icons.
/discipline/violations on a phone: the list starts halfway down the screen, under a header button row, area tabs, a pill row cut mid-word and a filter row cut mid-word.
/duty on a phone: the 'Catat manual' mode is fully off-screen with nothing showing that it exists.
Every empty list: the header button and the empty-state button are the same primary action, side by side in one view.

findings.title: Fourth duty mode 'Catat manual' is invisible on the phone
findings.description: The mode switch under 'Piket hari ini' shows 'Masuk kelas | Terlambat | Izin keluar' and ends cleanly at the right edge of its pill track. 'Catat manual', the only way to record a student who has no phone, sits completely past the edge with no text, fade or arrow to show it is there. This holds for every role. Before the overhaul all three modes were visible.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/duty-view.tsx:115-121 passes four options to SegmentedControl. packages/ui/src/components/segmented-control.tsx:150-151 makes every segment as wide as the widest label (grid auto-cols-fr, w-max): about 115px x 4, which is more than the 358px track. The scroll edge falls exactly on the boundary after 'Izin keluar', so only the fourth segment's padding is in view and the edge fade has nothing to fade.
findings.fix: Make all four fit. Pass size="dense" and fullWidth="phone", and shorten app.duty.purposes to one word each (Masuk, Terlambat, Keluar, Manual), so each gets about 89px. Alternative: take 'Catat manual' out of the mode switch (it is a task, not a QR mode) and make it the AppPage primaryAction opening DutyManualRecordPanel, leaving three segments that fit.

findings.title: Pelanggaran on a phone is all chrome: three sideways scrollers before the list
findings.description: The first phone screen stacks five rows of controls before any content: a full-width 'Catat pelanggaran' row, the area tabs, a four-pill sub-tab track cut mid-word ('Katalog pelanggar|', with 'Kebijakan SP' out of view), the search row, then a filter-pill row also cut mid-word ('Rentang ta|'). The list starts at 51% of the screen height. Dark mode looks the same.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/violations-view.tsx:66-71 puts two settings editors (violation catalog and SP policy) beside the two data views as sibling pill tabs, which makes the track too wide for 358px. packages/ui/src/components/page-header.tsx:248-262 gives primaryAction its own row on a phone. The DataTable filter pills scroll as a separate row (packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-filters.tsx:171-177).
findings.fix: Move 'Katalog pelanggaran' and 'Kebijakan SP' into AppPage secondaryActions. They become buttons on desktop and items in the existing overflow menu on the phone, opening ViolationCatalogView and DisciplinePolicyView on their own routes or in a Sheet. That leaves 'Catatan poin / Kandidat SP', which fits on one line. The header button row is covered by kesiswaan-1-03.

findings.title: Two identical primary buttons on every empty list
findings.description: Empty lists show the same green button twice in one view: 'Catat prestasi' in the header and 'Catat prestasi' in the empty state. The same happens with 'Tambah kegiatan', 'Catat konseling' and 'Catat pelanggaran', on desktop and phone. On the phone the header copy also takes a full-width row between the title and the tabs. For gurubk on Pelanggaran, the raised centre tab 'Catat' makes three entries for one action on a single screen.
findings.cause: Each view passes a primary Button as the EmptyState action while AppPage primaryAction renders the same button: apps/web/features/activities/components/achievements-view.tsx:149-159 and 190-200, activities-calendar-view.tsx:147-163, apps/web/features/discipline/components/counseling-view.tsx:176-190, violations-ledger-view.tsx:267-281.
findings.fix: Keep one primary button per view. When the page header already carries the action, render the empty-state copy with variant="secondary" or drop it. Do it once: give FirstUseEmptyState (packages/ui/src/components/first-use-empty-state.tsx) an emphasis="secondary" option and switch these four views to it.

findings.title: Early-warning level tiles shrink to 80px squares at the left of an empty row
findings.description: The Berisiko / Siaga / Aman tiles are about 80px wide each, flush left, leaving about 880px of the row empty on desktop and about 70px on the phone. Each tile's chevron is jammed against its icon circle. The chevron also says 'go to' although the tiles are filter toggles. The summary that should answer 'who needs attention today' looks unfinished. Same for every role.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/analytics/components/risk-level-summary.tsx:42 renders StatGrid inside the AppPage toolbar, which is a flex flex-wrap row (packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:143-147), so the dl shrinks to its content. The grid-cols-3 override also leaves StatGrid's default sm:grid-cols-4 in place (packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:105). packages/ui/src/components/stat.tsx:298-302 draws ChevronRight on every interactive tile, including onClick/selected toggles.
findings.fix: Set className="w-full grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-3" on the StatGrid in risk-level-summary.tsx. In stat.tsx, show the tile chevron only when href is set, not for button toggles.

findings.title: SP meter legend sits one tick to the left of its markers
findings.description: In 'Rekap poin' the bar has ticks labelled SP 1, SP 2 and SP 3 at 33%, 66% and 100%. Under it, the legend 'SP 1 · 25 / SP 2 · 50 / SP 3 · 75' starts at 0%, 33% and 66%. So 'SP 2 · 50' sits directly under the SP 1 tick and 'SP 3 · 75' under the SP 2 tick, and the tick labels repeat the legend. The sentence '25 poin lagi menuju SP 1' also comes before the '0 poin' figure it explains.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/points-meter.tsx:53-60 passes labelled markers to Progress, and :61 lays the legend out as grid auto-cols-fr grid-flow-col, equal thirds that start at the left edge rather than at each threshold. apps/web/features/discipline/components/student-discipline-panel.tsx:111-119 orders the CardDescription before the figure.
findings.fix: Drop label from the Progress markers (keep the ticks). Position each legend item at its threshold: absolutely at left: min_points/scaleMax*100% with -translate-x-full and text-right, or right-align each cell when the thresholds are evenly spaced. Put the '0 poin' figure above the 'poin lagi menuju' sentence.

findings.title: Raw ISO dates under club members
findings.description: Each member row shows '2026-11-17' as its meta line, while the date picker a few pixels above writes the same day as '17 November 2026'. Seen on desktop and phone.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/club-detail-view.tsx:175 builds meta from the raw m.joined_on and m.left_on strings. formatDate is imported in the file but not used here. The prestasi table has the same gap: apps/web/features/activities/components/achievements-view.tsx:110 renders achieved_on with no cell formatter.
findings.fix: Format with formatDate(m.joined_on, { locale, timeZone: "UTC" }) behind a label such as 'Bergabung 17 Nov 2026' (and '- 3 Des 2026' for left_on). Give the achieved_on column a cell that does the same.

findings.title: Club detail is built unlike its siblings and looks unfinished
findings.description: Instead of a header action and a dialog, an inline form row (Siswa, Tanggal bergabung, a pale disabled 'Daftarkan') sits above the members list. On the phone 'Daftarkan' wraps to a row of its own. The member search is a bare input with no search icon, beside a checkbox, unlike the DataTable toolbar on the list page. The header gives no club facts (jadwal, kuota, lokasi, jumlah anggota), and on desktop the page is mostly empty. 'Keluarkan' ends a membership in one tap with no confirmation.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/club-detail-view.tsx:105-140 (inline join form), :142-159 (raw Input and Checkbox), :181-205 (leave.mutate straight from the button). MeetingsPanel repeats the inline-form pattern at :232-259.
findings.fix: Make 'Daftarkan anggota' the AppPage primaryAction, opening a Dialog with StudentPicker and DatePicker (Field required). Replace the Input with the shared SearchInput and the checkbox with a boolean filter pill, or render members through DataTable mode="local". Show schedule, quota and location in the header description or a small DataList Card. Put 'Keluarkan' in a RowActionsMenu destructive item behind ConfirmDialog. Treat 'Jadwalkan pertemuan' the same way.

findings.title: Club row actions are two mismatched text buttons and the name gives no cue it opens the club
findings.description: Each club row ends in an outlined 'Ubah' and a ghost 'Hapus': two styles side by side, and 'Hapus' is not in a destructive tone. On the phone card both sit in the card header, the 'Ubah' pill nearly touching the card's top border and out of line with the title 'Pramuka (contoh)'. The club name, the only way into the club detail, looks like plain body text with no colour or chevron.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/clubs-view.tsx:120-150 renders two Buttons in the actions column. The phone card pulls that slot up with -my-2.5 (packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-cards.tsx:209). The name is a Link styled only as hover:underline (clubs-view.tsx:80-87), and no onRowActivate is set. achievements-view.tsx:111-139 uses the same two-button pattern.
findings.fix: Use RowActionsMenu with 'Ubah' and a destructive 'Hapus', as expected-guests-view.tsx does. Set onRowActivate to router.push(`/activities/clubs/${id}`), which gives the row its hover and the phone card its chevron. Render the name as plain text.

findings.title: Eyebrows disagree between sibling tabs, and /duty's eyebrow repeats its title
findings.description: In the counseling workspace (admin, gurubk) the tab 'Catatan konseling' has the eyebrow 'Konseling BK', while its sibling tab 'Peringatan dini' has 'Kesiswaan'. Switching tabs changes the line above the title. On /duty the eyebrow 'Piket' just repeats the title 'Piket hari ini', where every other area names its group.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/counseling-view.tsx:118 passes eyebrow={tNav("counseling")}. apps/web/features/analytics/components/at-risk-students-view.tsx:172-177 passes none, so AppPage falls back to the sidebar group (apps/web/components/app-page.tsx:132-135). apps/web/features/permits/components/duty-view.tsx:98 passes tNav("duty") = 'Piket'.
findings.fix: In at-risk-students-view, pass eyebrow = app.shell.nav.items.counseling whenever the counseling workspace tabs render for the reader, and keep the default 'Kesiswaan' for others. In duty-view, use app.shell.nav.groups.duty ('Piket dan gerbang').

findings.title: Tab strip jumps 4px when moving between tabs with and without a header action
findings.description: For admin, the 'Pelanggaran | Surat peringatan' strip sits at y=176 on Pelanggaran (which has 'Catat pelanggaran') and at y=172 on Surat peringatan (no action). Switching tabs nudges the whole strip and content. The same 4px offset separates admin and kepsek on Prestasi, Ekstrakurikuler and Agenda kegiatan.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/page-header.tsx:252: the actions row is sm:-mt-1 sm:min-h-10. It centres a 40px row on the 32px title line but only pulls up 4px, so it ends 4px below the title and makes the header taller whenever an action exists.
findings.fix: Use sm:-my-1 instead of sm:-mt-1, so the 40px row's margin box equals the 32px title line.

findings.title: Signals card mixes three value styles, and the identity header lacks NIS
findings.description: In 'Sinyal', attendance is body text over a full-width green bar, 'Pelanggaran' is a whole sentence ('0 poin pelanggaran aktif') set as a 22px bold number, 'Surat peringatan diterbitkan' is a bare '0', and 'Tren nilai rapor' is muted text. The four signals do not read as one set. The header shows avatar, name and profile link, but no NIS or class, which the discipline detail page for the same student does show.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/analytics/components/student-risk-panel.tsx:77-111, especially :92-94 (text-title-lg on a full sentence) and :97 (a bare number with no unit). apps/web/features/analytics/components/student-risk-detail-view.tsx:38-40 passes only the profile link as the description.
findings.fix: Give each signal the same shape: a number in text-title-lg plus a caption unit ('poin aktif', 'surat', 'dari 1 hari tidak hadir'), for example a plain Stat inside the dl, with the attendance bar under its number. Reuse the NIS plus profile-link description from student-discipline-view.tsx:113-118.

findings.title: 'Riwayat konseling' card uses a smaller inset than the cards above it
findings.description: The title 'Riwayat konseling' starts at x=281 on desktop and x=66 (2x) on the phone. 'Rekap poin' and 'Catatan pelanggaran' above it start at x=285 and x=74, so the left edge visibly steps in on the last card.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/discipline/components/student-counseling-history.tsx:99 uses Card padding="sm", while its siblings in student-discipline-panel.tsx:80 and :144 use md and the default.
findings.fix: Use Card padding="md".

findings.title: Activities forms: day select truncated, no required markers, unexplained disabled Simpan
findings.description: In 'Tambah ekstrakurikuler', 'Hari pertemuan' reads 'Belum dite...' in a three-column row although the dialog has room. The prestasi, ekskul and kegiatan forms mark no required fields, while 'Catat konseling' next door marks them with red asterisks. In 'Catat prestasi', 'Simpan' sits pale and disabled with no hint why. 'Tambah kegiatan' uses two separate DatePickers where the shared DateRangePicker exists.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/activities/components/club-form.tsx:130 (grid sm:grid-cols-3 for day, start and end). required is set on the controls, not on Field: club-form.tsx:90-96, achievements-view.tsx:305-341, activities-calendar-view.tsx:273-306. achievements-view.tsx:356 sets disabled={!studentId}. activities-calendar-view.tsx:303-306 has two DatePickers.
findings.fix: Put 'Hari pertemuan' on its own row and 'Jam mulai'/'Jam selesai' in grid-cols-2. Move required onto Field so the asterisk renders. Keep Simpan enabled and show the Field error on submit. Use DateRangePicker for the event dates.

findings.title: Early-warning phone cards are loose and the chevron floats above the name

reviews.verdict: This area is much better than before the overhaul and mostly looks professional. The hub has clear groups and its own "Akun saya" section. Merek sekolah and Kop laporan are proper two-pane editors with a live preview. Peran dan akses is now a readable matrix with counts, search, a "Diberikan" filter and a Select on the phone. The notification matrices finally show their off switches clearly, and dark mode holds up everywhere I looked. What lets it down is the frame. Pages that share one tab strip use different widths (centred 720px vs full width), so the title and tabs jump sideways on every tab change. The audit log's phone toolbar takes three rows, and one of them holds nothing but a "..." button. Several smaller things look unfinished: blank white preview sheets, a truncated template name on the phone, card text showing through the bottom tab bar, and a few leftover jargon strings. Both /platform routes were captured as 403 for every role, so the platform console itself was not reviewed.
best: Merek sekolah (desktop): form cards on the left, a live preview on the right that shows the tab, menu, buttons and sign-in page, plus a note that the app adjusts the accent per theme
Kop laporan: two-pane editor with a 'Langsung / PDF tersimpan' preview; the save bar appears only when there are changes
Peran dan akses: '81 dari 83 izin diberikan', permission search, a Semua/Diberikan switch, collapsible groups with counts; on the phone a role Select and collapsed groups
Notification matrix (Notifikasi bawaan, Preferensi notifikasi): off switches are now plainly visible, one shared component, sentence-case labels
Settings hub: grouped cards with one icon tone per group, search, and an 'Akun saya' section; the personal pages are linked as tabs
worst: Pages that share a tab strip use different widths (Templat dokumen and Notifikasi bawaan are centred at 720px; Merek sekolah, Kop laporan, Integrasi and Jejak audit are full width), so the header and tabs jump sideways when switching tabs
Jejak audit on the phone: the toolbar takes three rows, one holding only a '...' button; the first record starts halfway down the screen
Templat baru: an empty white preview sheet of about 380px on desktop and a whole blank screen on the phone
Templat dokumen on the phone: the template name is cut to 'Surat izin siswa (co...' next to a wide ghost 'Jadikan bawaan' button
Phone tab bar: card text shows crisply through it behind the tab labels

findings.title: Tab siblings use different page widths, so the header and tab strip jump when switching tabs
findings.description: Within one tab strip, some settings pages use a centred 720px column and others the full width. On desktop the breadcrumb, h1 and tabs start at x=480 on Templat dokumen but at x=264 on its siblings Merek sekolah and Kop laporan. In the Komunikasi group, Notifikasi bawaan is centred (x=480) while Integrasi (and WhatsApp) are full width (x=264). In the access group, Jejak audit is full width while Sesi dan masuk and Masuk dengan Google are narrow. Every tab click slides the whole header and the tab underline about 216px sideways, which makes the tabs feel like separate pages. The template editor (/settings/document-templates/new) also jumps away from its narrow list.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/settings-page.tsx:35 defaults to variant 'narrow'. branding-view.tsx:128, report-header-view.tsx:180, integrations-view.tsx:26 and whatsapp-settings-view.tsx:25 pass variant 'default', and audit-logs-view.tsx:220 passes 'fit'. packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:109 centres every variant with mx-auto, so the narrow 720px column, header and tabs included, sits in the middle while the default one starts at the left edge.
findings.fix: Make SettingsPage render AppPage with one width for every settings page: variant 'default' (keep 'fit' only where a page passes it). When a page asks for a narrow form, wrap its children in <div className="flex w-full max-w-narrow flex-col gap-6"> inside the content, not on the shell. The breadcrumb, title and tabs then start at the same x on every tab, and only the form body is 720px wide.

findings.title: The 'serviceWorker ... context is sandboxed' page error is very likely caused by the capture harness, not the app
findings.description: The capture recorded 'Failed to read the serviceWorker property from Navigator: Service worker is disabled because the context is sandboxed' on this route only. The only sandboxed frame on the page is the editor's preview iframe, which is sandbox="": scripts are off, so no app code can run in it. UpdateAvailable (apps/web/components/update-available.tsx) is mounted only once, in the top-level AppShell (app-shell.tsx:130), which is not sandboxed. What does run in every frame, sandboxed ones included, is the capture context's injected scripts. The context is created with serviceWorkers: 'block', which makes Playwright inject an init script into every frame that reads navigator.serviceWorker to stub register(). That is why register() resolves to undefined, as the tool's own comment at lib.mjs:206 notes. Reading navigator.serviceWorker in an opaque-origin sandboxed frame throws exactly this SecurityError. The screen itself renders correctly.
findings.cause: capture-tool/lib.mjs:120 (serviceWorkers: 'block') runs Playwright's injected stub in the sandboxed about:srcdoc preview frame created at apps/web/features/documents/components/template-editor.tsx:318-322; lib.mjs:204-209 records the resulting exception as a page error.
findings.fix: No app change is needed; keep sandbox="" on the preview, which is the safe setting. In the capture tool's pageerror filter (lib.mjs:206), ignore /context is sandboxed/ the same way it already ignores "reading 'waiting'". Or set serviceWorkers to 'allow' and keep the existing 'waiting' filter.

findings.title: Personal notification preferences list the same 12 kinds for every role
findings.description: All nine roles see the same 12 rows, so siswa, satpam and pustakawan are asked how to receive 'Permintaan guru pengganti' and 'Respon guru pengganti', and siswa is asked about 'Pengajuan izin baru' (a reviewer's notification). On the phone this makes the page about 2.5 screens of switches (4494px at 2x), mostly for events the reader will never get.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/notifications/api.ts:33-62: NOTIFICATION_KIND_MODULE and useNotificationKinds filter kinds only by the school's enabled modules, never by whether the reader can be a recipient.
findings.fix: Add a NOTIFICATION_KIND_AUDIENCE record next to NOTIFICATION_KIND_MODULE that maps each kind to the permissions that make a reader its recipient. For example, substitution_* goes to roles with a teaching or substitution permission, and leave_request_submitted to the leave reviewer permission. Keep undefined for kinds everyone receives. Add a useOwnNotificationKinds() that filters by me.permissions, and use it in notification-settings-view.tsx (not in notification-defaults-view.tsx, which must keep the full list).

findings.title: Theme tiles squeeze their hints into a narrow column ('Ikuti sistem' wraps to five lines)

After the icon on the left and the radio on the right, the text column is only about 110px, so 'Mengikuti / pengaturan / terang atau / gelap / perangkat.' breaks over five lines, 'Gelap' over three and 'Terang' over two. findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/appearance-view.tsx:50 uses 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3' inside the narrow FormSection card.

findings.title: On the phone the settings hub is a stack of 16 separate cards (2.7 screens), not a settings list
findings.description: Each hub entry is its own bordered card of about 100px with 12px gaps, so the admin hub runs to 4556px at 2x, about 2.7 screens. A phone settings screen is normally one grouped, inset list per section with hairline dividers. That would cut the height by roughly 40% and feel like a native app, which is the owner's bar for the phone.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/settings-hub-view.tsx:90-109 renders each card as <Card interactive> in a 'grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2' list at every width.
findings.fix: Below sm, render each section's cards as one <List framed> of <ListRow> rows (leading IconCircle in the section tone, title = label, meta = description, href, chevron). Keep the two-column Card grid from sm up. The templates page already uses this List/ListRow pattern.

findings.title: Hub section description promises cards the reader cannot see
findings.description: For kepsek, 'Akses dan keamanan' is described as 'Pengguna, peran, sesi masuk, dan jejak audit.', but the only card under it is Jejak audit. The other four are hidden by access, so the description lists things that are not there.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/settings-hub-view.tsx:88 always prints the static section description, while apps/web/features/settings/settings-hub.ts:125-135 drops the cards the reader cannot open.
findings.fix: Have buildSettingsHubSections return complete: cards.length === section.cards.length (when there is no query), and pass the SectionHeader description only when the section is complete. Alternatively, build the description from the visible card labels.

findings.title: Page text shows crisply through the phone tab bar behind its labels
findings.description: On every phone shot the text of the card under the bar stays readable through it and collides with the tab labels. Examples: 'Atur peran dan hak akses setiap pengguna.' behind 'Tindakan / Aksi cepat' on the hub, 'Menerbitkan dokumen' on Jejak audit, 'Permintaan guru pengganti' on Preferensi notifikasi, 'pengguna.' in dark mode. The ghost text is sharp, not blurred, so whenever backdrop blur is not composited (as in this capture) the bar looks dirty.
findings.cause: apps/web/components/mobile-tab-bar.tsx:161 uses 'bg-surface/85 backdrop-blur-xl'; 15% transparency is enough for body text to read through when the blur does not apply.
findings.fix: Raise the bar's opacity to bg-surface/95 (blur kept). Or use 'bg-surface supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-surface/90' so a browser without backdrop-filter gets an opaque bar.

findings.title: Three different card insets on one page: 24, 20 and 16px
findings.description: On Preferensi notifikasi, 'Waktu pengiriman' (FormSection card) is inset 24px on desktop, the 'Kanal per jenis' header (Card) 20px, and the matrix rows and table cells 16px. On the phone the row titles ('Pengumuman baru') sit about 4px left of the card title above them in the same card. Desktop Merek sekolah, Kop laporan and the template editor mix 24px form cards with a 20px Pratinjau card.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/form-layout.tsx:57 uses 'p-5 md:p-6' for FormSection variant card, while Card/CardHeader use p-5 (card.tsx:137) and apps/web/features/settings/components/notification-channel-matrix.tsx:120 uses px-4 for the phone rows (table cells use the default 16px).
findings.fix: Use one inset: change form-layout.tsx:57 to 'p-5' (drop md:p-6), change notification-channel-matrix.tsx:120 to 'px-5', and give the matrix table 'first:pl-5 last:pr-5' on its head and body cells.

findings.description: The template editor hint reads 'Gunakan {{nama_placeholder}} untuk bagian yang diisi otomatis...', putting template syntax in front of a TU operator who already has 'Sisipkan data otomatis' buttons, and its field label is 'Isi (HTML)'. Integrasi's description says 'Kelola akses mesin ke data sekolah: kunci API untuk memanggil endpoint...'. The notification matrices say 'Respon guru pengganti' (non-standard Indonesian; the app elsewhere uses 'Tanggapan').
findings.cause: apps/web/messages/features/documents.id.json:34-35 (bodyLabel, bodyHint); apps/web/messages/features/integrations.id.json:5 and :19; apps/web/messages/id.json:777 (substitution_responded).
findings.fix: documents.id.json: bodyLabel 'Isi templat', bodyHint 'Pakai tombol Sisipkan data otomatis di bawah untuk bagian yang diisi saat dokumen diterbitkan.' integrations.id.json:5 'Hubungkan aplikasi lain ke data sekolah: kunci API untuk mengambil data, dan webhook untuk mengirim kabar saat ada kejadian baru.'; :19 '...memberi aplikasi lain akses ke data sekolah ini.' id.json:777 'Tanggapan guru pengganti'.

findings.title: Density and column icons float over an empty table
findings.description: On Kunci API with no keys, the density and column icons sit alone at the far right (y=413), above the 'Belum ada kunci API' empty state. They have nothing to act on and look like stray controls.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table.tsx:401 always renders DataTableToolbar, and data-table-toolbar.tsx:261 always shows the view-icon group from md up, whatever the row count.
findings.fix: Pass hasRows (table.getRowModel().rows.length > 0 || isLoading) to DataTableToolbar and render the density and column icons only when hasRows is true or a filter or search is active. Also extend the existing emptyOnPhone check so the whole toolbar hides when it would hold only those icons.

findings.title: Forbidden page tells the school admin to ask the school admin
findings.description: On /platform and /platform/operator-alerts, the Admin Sekolah sees 'Minta admin sekolah membuka aksesnya bila Anda memerlukan halaman ini.' The reader is the school admin, and these pages belong to the platform operator, so no school admin can open them. The advice is circular and wrong.
findings.cause: apps/web/components/forbidden-page.tsx:25 always uses app.forbidden.body, apps/web/messages/id.json:733.
findings.fix: Let ForbiddenPage take an optional reason from RouteGuard. For routes guarded by a platform permission, show a new message such as 'Halaman ini khusus operator platform.' For everything else, use a neutral body such as 'Akun Anda belum punya izin untuk halaman ini. Hubungi admin sekolah bila Anda memerlukannya.', and choose a variant without the last sentence when the reader is already a school admin.

findings.title: Logo and favicon rows do not line up
findings.description: In 'Logo dan favicon' the Logo preview box is 64px and the Favicon box 48px, so their titles and hints start at different x (369 vs 353 on desktop, 145 vs 125 on the phone). On the phone the hints also wrap to three lines with an orphaned '2 MB.' and 'KB.'.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/brand-asset-upload.tsx:110-112 sizes the preview box itself ('size-16' for the logo, 'size-12' for the favicon) with nothing reserving a common slot.
findings.fix: Wrap the preview in a fixed slot, <div className="flex w-16 shrink-0 justify-center">, so both text columns start at the same x. On the phone, drop the format list from the hint (keep 'Maksimal 2 MB') or move it under the row.

findings.title: On the phone the live preview sits at the very end, out of sight while typing
findings.description: Kop laporan and Merek sekolah both say 'Berubah langsung saat Anda mengetik, sebelum disimpan.' On the phone, though, the preview is the last card, two screens below the fields, so the live feedback cannot be seen while editing.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/settings/components/report-header-view.tsx:196 and branding-view.tsx:145 use a single grid that becomes two columns only at lg, so below lg the preview simply follows the form.
findings.fix: Below lg, give the preview a 'Lihat pratinjau' secondary button near the top (or in the save bar) that opens it in a bottom Sheet, and hide the trailing card with 'max-lg:hidden'. Keep the side pane from lg up.

baseline.note: One frame now: the breadcrumb 'Pengaturan sekolah > page', and tabs that come from the hub section taxonomy. Still split: page widths differ between tab siblings (finding 01), and Peran dan akses opens in the Data sekolah workspace under another title.

Hub card, tab and title now share one label (Kop laporan, Notifikasi bawaan, Jejak audit, Integrasi, Masuk dengan Google). Only roles differs: card 'Peran dan akses', page 'Pengguna dan akses' with that as the tab.

reviews.verdict: On desktop the library area now meets the bar in most places. Catalogue, copies, title detail, the circulation desk, class loans and import all sit on one template with one tab style, real cards, a single primary action and readable tables. Dark mode holds up. But the phone and the routing let it down. The library dashboard on a phone is wider than the screen (the layout viewport grows to 603px, cards run off the right edge and the bottom tab bar is gone). That is a regression; the old dashboard fit. The settings hub ignores ?section= after a client-side navigation, so /library/master-data and /library/member-types land on "Aturan peminjaman". The phone cards in the desk's overdue queue are crowded and cut the book title, the kiosk leaves half its screen empty, and the loan-rules empty state shows two primary buttons. The headmaster's dashboard offers links to circulation pages that role cannot open. With the two blockers fixed, this area would score 8.

Tambah judul form: ISBN first, grouped sections, sticky footer, and a real bottom sheet on the phone
/library/import: a shared FileDropzone and stepper replace the native English file input

/library/desk phone overdue cards: the Kembalikan button squeezes the text column, the book title is cut without an ellipsis and two identical cards have different spacing

findings.title: Library dashboard is wider than the phone; cards run off screen and the tab bar disappears
findings.description: On a 390px phone every card below the collection strip runs past the right edge: the chart card, 'Judul paling sering dipinjam', 'Peminjaman terbaru' and 'Paling lama terlambat'. Text is cut mid-word ('30 hari terakhi', 'pengemba'), the 'x kali dipinjam' counts are off screen and the overdue badges show only 'Terlambat 3'. The capture measured innerWidth 603 for all three roles, so the browser widened the layout viewport to fit the content. That pushes the fixed bottom tab bar below the visible screen: it is missing from the fold shots of admin, kepsek and pustakawan. The old dashboard fit the phone, so this is a regression.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/library-dashboard-view.tsx:106 uses `grid items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3` with no column template below lg. The single implicit track is `auto`, so it grows to the widest min-content of its cards. In ListRow the title is `truncate` (nowrap) and the trailing DueBadge is nowrap (packages/ui/src/components/list-row.tsx:160-198). The 'Paling lama terlambat' row ('Sapiens: Riwayat Singkat Umat Manusia' + 'Terlambat 33 hari (jatuh tempo 15 Okt)') sets a minimum near 603px.
findings.fix: Change the grid to `grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3`. grid-cols-1 is minmax(0,1fr), so the ListRow titles truncate inside the screen. Re-check the phone: the overdue rows should end in the badge and a chevron inside the card, and the bottom bar should be back.

findings.title: Settings hub ignores ?section= after a client navigation; master-data opens 'Aturan peminjaman'
findings.description: /library/master-data redirects to /library/settings?section=masterData, and the capture confirms that final URL. The page still shows the 'Aturan peminjaman' tab and the loan-rules empty state, on desktop and phone. /library/member-types (redirected to ?section=memberTypes) shows the same wrong section. So the old addresses do not reach catalogue data or member types. The same mechanism almost certainly leaves the hub's own tab links (Next Link to ?section=...) stuck on the first section, which was not captured.
findings.cause: apps/web/lib/hooks/use-url-state.ts:13-19 reads `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)` during render whenever window exists. On an App Router navigation (router.replace in master-data-page.tsx:27-31, the redirect, or a NavTabs Link in library-settings-view.tsx:70-80), Next renders the new tree first and writes the URL to history afterwards in an insertion effect. The render therefore reads the old URL and falls back to the default 'loanRules', and nothing re-renders the hub once history has the new URL.
findings.fix: In use-url-state.ts, take the value from `searchParams` (from next/navigation, which matches the navigation being rendered and in Next 15 also follows native pushState/replaceState). If the window read must stay because of the service worker's history wrapper, at least add `useEffect(() => { refresh((v) => v + 1); }, [searchParams]);` so the hook re-reads window.location once Next has committed the URL. Then check that /library/master-data, /library/member-types and each settings tab click show their own section.

findings.title: Headmaster's dashboard links to circulation pages the role cannot open
findings.description: The headmaster's sidebar offers only Dasbor, Katalog and Pinjaman buku under Perpustakaan, so the role has no circulation or member access. The dashboard still shows the header action 'Buka meja sirkulasi' and four tiles with chevrons pointing to /library/desk, /library/desk#desk-overdue and /library/visits. findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/library-dashboard-view.tsx:51 (actions), :66, :74, :83 and :91 (Stat href), and apps/web/features/library/components/dashboard-activity-lists.tsx:94, :103 and :120 set the hrefs unconditionally. The dashboard is offered to anyone with view_library_reports (lib/navigation-library.ts:24-28 and :50), but /library/desk and /library/visits need manage_library_circulation and /library/members needs manage_library_members.
findings.fix: Gate the links with `useCan`. Render the header TextLink and the tile hrefs only when `useCan('manage_library_circulation')`; without it the tiles stay plain stats with no chevron. In DashboardActivityLists, pass the members href and the 'followUpAll' action only when `useCan('manage_library_members')` and `useCan('manage_library_circulation')` respectively. The rows then render without href and without a chevron.

findings.title: Overdue queue cards on the phone: button squeezes the text, book title cut, uneven spacing

The member and book text is squeezed into the left half. The second card shows 'Sapiens: Riwayat Singkat', cut with no ellipsis. findings.title: Area tabs and filter pills hide the next item completely, so the scroll is not discoverable
findings.description: On the Sirkulasi pages the phone tab strip shows 'Sirkulasi / Peminjaman kelas / Denda dan sanksi'. findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/tab-styles.tsx:41-46 (stripScrollerClass) and packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-filters.tsx:173-177 scroll inside the 16px page gutter, so the next item can only appear when it happens to straddle the edge. The scroll-fade-x mask (packages/ui/src/styles.css:435-449) fades only what is already visible.
findings.fix: On phones, let these scrollers bleed into the gutter, so the next item always peeks into the 16px margin and the fade has something to fade. For example, add `max-sm:-mx-4 max-sm:px-4 max-sm:scroll-px-4` to the underline strip scroller and to the filter pill row.

findings.title: Phone cards whose title is a link get a 44px title box and a loose, uneven gap

findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-cards.tsx:77-79: LIFT_CONTROLS adds `[&_a]:inline-flex [&_a]:min-h-11` to the title (line 197), so the 44px hit area becomes layout height.
findings.fix: Keep the touch target without changing layout. In LIFT_CONTROLS replace `[&_a]:min-h-11` with an overlay: `[&_a]:after:absolute [&_a]:after:-inset-y-3 [&_a]:after:inset-x-0 [&_a]:after:content-['']`, keeping `[&_a]:relative`. Or use `[&_a]:py-2.5 [&_a]:-my-2.5` so the box grows without moving its neighbours.

findings.title: Collection strip ends in a hard-cut 'Tersedia' against the rounded border
findings.description: The seven-figure collection strip scrolls sideways on the phone. Its last visible figure, '4 Tersedia', touches the card's rounded right border with no fade or padding, and four more figures (Dipinjam, Anggota, Anggota aktif, Denda) are hidden with no hint.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:82-92: StatStrip is `overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none` with no edge cue. It tracks `overflows` only to set tabIndex.
findings.fix: Give the strip the same cue as tab strips: call useScrollEdges(scrollerRef, { axis: 'x' }) and add `scroll-fade-x` to the scroller class. Alternatively, wrap on phones instead of scrolling: `max-sm:grid max-sm:grid-cols-3 max-sm:divide-x-0` on the dl, so seven small figures fit in three rows.

reviews.verdict: Against the pre-overhaul screens, the second half of the library area is a big step up. Every route now uses the one template (eyebrow, h1, underline tabs, shared DataTable). Phone dialogs are real bottom sheets with sticky Batal and Simpan buttons, the visit kiosk is calm and clear, and Pinjaman buku on a phone answers "what do I owe" first. The tables, filter pills and empty states look the same from page to page, and the date pickers and badges are consistent. Visible defects still undo that impression. The Laporan page's first tab reads "reports", a label key leaking through. The old /library/member-types link opens the wrong section. On a phone the stat strips cut text mid-word and hide the stocktake's "Hilang" count. The desktop stocktake camera fills the screen and pushes the barcode field below the fold. A filled "Lanjutkan pindai" button is wedged into a card corner, a member's due badge is truncated mid-date, and on several screens the table's "..." menu sits alone on its own row. A designer would call it professional in structure but not yet clean enough to ship.
best: Phone dialogs (Catat pelanggaran, Catat kunjungan, Tambah aturan) are proper bottom sheets with a grab handle and sticky Batal/Simpan.
Visit kiosk: a three-step instruction card beside a large QR that renews itself, with a visible countdown and no raw token.
Pinjaman buku on a phone: the overdue hero comes first, and the reason renewal is refused is written under the button instead of hidden in a tooltip.
Members list and its phone cards are tidy, follow the shared DataTable, and use one badge style.

findings.title: Raw key "reports" shown as the first tab on Laporan
findings.description: The area tab row under the Laporan title reads "reports | Laporan perpustakaan | Rekap kunjungan". The first tab is the lowercase English registry key instead of "Pusat laporan". It is the first thing under the header, on desktop and phone.
findings.cause: AppPage builds the area tabs from the registry and falls back to the entry key when the label is missing: apps/web/components/app-page.tsx:155 `label(tab.labelKey) ?? tab.key`. The reports entry's labelKey is app.reports.navLabel (lib/navigation-settings.ts:63-65). /library/* runs under its own NextIntlClientProvider with LIBRARY_NAMESPACES (apps/web/lib/i18n/namespace-sets.ts:189-196), which does not carry app.reports. So t.has() is false there and the key prints.
findings.fix: Add "app.reports.navLabel" to LIBRARY_NAMESPACES in lib/i18n/namespace-sets.ts. Better, derive it there from the labelKeys of the workspace entries a library route can show, the way LIBRARY_NAV_LABEL_KEYS is derived. Also change app-page.tsx:155 so a tab whose label does not resolve is left out (with a dev warning) instead of printing its key.

findings.title: Old member-types link lands on the wrong settings section
findings.description: The capture log shows the redirect ended at /library/settings?section=memberTypes. The page still renders with "Aturan peminjaman" underlined and the loan-rule empty state, not the Jenis anggota list, on desktop and phone.
findings.cause: app/(app)/library/member-types/page.tsx:4-5 (and loan-rules/page.tsx) use a page-level redirect(). next.config.ts:46-51 explains that once the (app) shell has streamed, the browser performs these as a client router replace. lib/hooks/use-url-state.ts:14-16 reads `new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)` during render. Next 15 writes its own navigations to history only in a useInsertionEffect after render (node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router.js:91-113), so during that render the old URL has no section, LibrarySettingsView (library-settings-view.tsx:46-50) falls back to "loanRules", and nothing re-renders afterwards. Likely the same stale read on every Link into a useUrlState screen, such as the "Jenis anggota" and "Laporan" header shortcuts on /library/members (library-workspace-nav.tsx:115,154). Not verified in a browser.
findings.fix: Add ["/library/member-types", "/library/settings?section=memberTypes"] and ["/library/loan-rules", "/library/settings?section=loanRules"] to the `moved` list in next.config.ts and delete the two redirect pages. Then make useUrlState read `searchParams.get(key)` from useSearchParams() only. Next 15 patches pushState and replaceState into it (app-router.js:290-330), so the window.location read and the popstate refresh can go.

findings.title: Phone stat strips cut figures mid-word with no fade
findings.description: In the stocktake progress card, only "4 Diharapkan" and "2 Terpindai" fit. A sliver of the red icon of "Hilang" pokes in at the right border and "Salah tempat" is gone. The missing count, the point of the card, is invisible without an undiscoverable sideways swipe. On Kunjungan the strip ends in "Anggota berbeda h" cut mid-word, and the third figure is off-screen.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:82-92: the strip variant scrolls sideways (`overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none`, `dl` is `w-max`) with no edge fade or other hint. The tab strips and DataTableFilters do have one (`scroll-fade-x` driven by useScrollEdges, data-table-filters.tsx:163-177). Used at stocktake-session-view.tsx:246 and visits-view.tsx:173.
findings.fix: In StatStrip, call useScrollEdges(scrollerRef, { axis: "x" }) and add `scroll-fade-x` to the scroller, as the filter strip does. For the stocktake progress (four figures where Hilang matters) use `variant="tiles"`, which is 2x2 on a phone, so no figure is ever off-screen.

findings.title: Desktop stocktake camera fills the screen and buries the barcode field
findings.description: At 1440x900 the Pindai eksemplar card holds a 4:3 camera feed about 1110x830px. The Barcode eksemplar input and Catat button, which a librarian with a USB scanner actually uses, start at y~1380, far below the fold. The scan feed would sit below them.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/scanner-viewfinder.tsx:155 sizes the viewfinder `aspect-[4/3] w-full`. scanner.tsx:279-284 uses the side-by-side lg grid and scanner.tsx:308 the `max-h-[min(60dvh,34rem)]` cap only for the kiosk variant, so the `action` variant used by stocktake-session-view.tsx:280 grows with the card width.
findings.fix: In scanner.tsx, give the action variant the same `lg:grid lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,7fr)_minmax(0,5fr)] lg:items-start` layout and a height cap on the viewfinder (for example `max-h-[min(45dvh,24rem)]`). The camera, the barcode field, Catat and the feed then sit side by side above the fold.

findings.title: Row button "Lanjutkan pindai" is a second primary and is wedged into the card corner
findings.description: The open session row carries a filled green "Lanjutkan pindai" next to the header's primary "Mulai sesi baru", giving two primaries in view on both viewports. On the phone card the button sits about 3px below the card's top border and 8px from its right edge, and squeezes the session name into two lines.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/stocktake-view.tsx:83-97 renders a text Button with `variant="primary"` for open sessions in the column id "actions". data-table-cards.tsx:208-211 puts that column in the corner slot meant for an icon menu and pulls it up and out with `-my-2.5 -mr-2`.
findings.fix: Use `variant="secondary"` for the row button so the page has one primary. Rename the column id (for example "open") with `meta: { card: "meta", align: "end" }` so on a phone it sits in the meta row under the title. Alternatively use `card: "hidden"`, since the title already links to the session.

findings.title: Two rows of scrolling tabs on the phone report page
findings.description: Under the header the phone shows the hub's underline tabs (cut at "Rekap kunjunga") and then a seven-pill segmented strip (cut at "Paling sering"). Both scroll sideways, and the first screen is mostly navigation before the period field and an empty state with no next step.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/library-reports-view.tsx:153-156 leaves `nav` undefined on its own route, so AppPage adds the reports-hub tabs. Lines 175-181 then add a TabsList of all seven reports.
findings.fix: Below md, render the seven reports as a Select labelled "Jenis laporan" bound to the same `tab` state, and keep the pill TabsList from md up. The phone then has one tab row, the hub's.

findings.title: Loan card truncates the title and the due badge mid-date
findings.description: Under "Sedang dipinjam" the card reads "Sapiens: Riwayat Singkat Uma..." and the badge "Terlambat 33 hari (jatuh tempo 1...", so the due date is lost. Meanwhile the left icon circle and the right "..." take about a third of the width.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/member-loan-row.tsx:50-57: a row with a 40px IconCircle, gap-3 and a 44px RowActionsMenu leaves about 226px. The title span is `truncate`, and DueBadge (due-badge.tsx:37-45) renders a single-line Badge that truncates by design.
findings.fix: In member-loan-row.tsx, hide the IconCircle below sm (`className="max-sm:hidden"`) and change the title span from `truncate` to `line-clamp-2`. The badge then fits. Alternatively drop the date from the overdue badge, since the caption under it already says how late.

findings.title: Member summary card stacks a lone 64px avatar above a one-column list
findings.description: On the phone the summary card is about 390px tall. A big "GC" avatar sits alone on the first row with empty space to its right, then three label/value pairs stacked one per row, then the status. The loans tabs start below the fold.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/member-detail-view.tsx:209-220: the Card is `sm:flex-row`, so below sm the Avatar takes its own row. DataList `columns={3}` collapses to one column on a phone.
findings.fix: Move the Avatar into AppPage's `leading` prop (the template's slot for an avatar before the title of a page about one person, components/app-page.tsx:35) and remove it from the card. Use `columns={2}` so the facts pair up, which roughly halves the card on a phone.

findings.title: Table view options take a row of their own
findings.description: On a phone, an unlabelled "..." (column menu) sits alone on a full row: above the Status and Jenis pills (violations), above the date pill (visits), and between the actions and the empty state (settings). On members it reads like a second page overflow next to the header's "...". On desktop the density and column icons sit alone on a row above the table or empty state (reports y~388, stocktake list y~238).
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-toolbar.tsx:258-302: the view-options group is `order-2 ml-auto` while the filters are `order-4 basis-full`, so with no search box the menu wraps alone. The rule at lines 210-214 hides the phone toolbar only when there is no search, no filters and no actions, and never hides it on desktop.
findings.fix: In data-table-toolbar.tsx, do not render the phone Ellipsis menu when `!showSearch` (column choice on cards is low value). When there is no search, no filters and no actions, hide the toolbar at every width (`hidden` instead of `max-md:hidden`), or place the two icons in the table header row instead of a toolbar row.

findings.title: The same create action appears as two filled primaries
findings.description: With an empty list, "Tambah aturan" appears as a filled primary in the toolbar and again as a filled primary in the empty state. Violations does the same with "Catat pelanggaran" in the header and the empty state. That makes two primaries in view on both viewports.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/loan-rules-view.tsx:164-178 passes the same `addButton` to `toolbarActions` and to the EmptyState `action`. violations-view.tsx:212 and 268-272 pass `recordButton` to both `primaryAction` and the EmptyState.
findings.fix: Keep the header or toolbar button as the one primary and give the empty state a `variant="secondary"` copy of the action (or none) while the same action is already in view.

findings.title: Overdue hero offers "Jelajahi katalog", and the lateness has two colours
findings.description: The amber "1 buku terlambat 42 hari" hero ends in a "Jelajahi katalog" link, an action that has nothing to do with returning a late book. Right under it the same lateness is a red danger pill ("Terlambat 42 hari (jatuh tempo 6 Okt)") with a red book icon, while the hero chip "Terlambat" is amber-brown. That is one status in two colours on one screen.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/my-library-view.tsx:177-187 passes `secondaryAction={browse}` to the warning HeroCard. due-badge.tsx:11-15 maps overdue to `danger`, and HeroCard has no danger tone (packages/ui/src/components/hero-card.tsx:7).
findings.fix: Drop `secondaryAction` from the overdue hero, or point it at the loan card below. Use one tone for "Terlambat" on the page: add a `danger` tone to HeroCard and use it for the overdue hero, or have DueBadge use `warning` for overdue everywhere.

findings.title: Librarian and admin are told to ask the librarian to register them
findings.description: The not-a-member empty state says "Minta pustakawan mendaftarkan Anda..." to everyone, including the Pustakawan and Admin Sekolah who can register members themselves.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/my-library-view.tsx:71-83 always shows `notMemberBody` (messages/features/library.id.json:1516) with only a "Jelajahi katalog" action.
findings.fix: When the reader has `manage_library_members`, show a second description (for example "Daftarkan diri Anda di halaman Anggota") with a secondary link to /library/members. Keep the current copy for everyone else.

findings.title: Pinjaman buku header jumps to a centred 720px column
findings.description: Every sibling library page puts its eyebrow and h1 at the content's left edge (x=264). Pinjaman buku centres the whole page, header included, in a 720px column starting at x=480, with large empty gutters. Moving between Katalog and Pinjaman buku in the sidebar makes the title jump sideways.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/my-library-view.tsx:55,63,71,95 use `AppPage variant="narrow"`. PageShell centres every variant (`mx-auto`, packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:109), and narrow is documented for forms and settings (page-shell.tsx:18).
findings.fix: Use the default variant and cap only the content (contentClassName="max-w-3xl"), so the header stays aligned with its siblings while the loan cards keep a readable width.

findings.title: Running session calls not-yet-scanned books "Hilang"
findings.description: While the session is still open, the progress strip shows "2 Hilang" in red for the two copies not scanned yet. Mid-count they are not lost, so the label alarms the librarian before the count is done.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/stocktake-session-view.tsx:265 reuses the closed-result label `result.missing` ("Hilang") for the live progress figure.
findings.fix: Add a progress key such as `progress.remaining: "Belum terpindai"` (id and en) and use it at line 265 with a neutral or amber category. Keep "Hilang" for the closed results.

findings.title: Required member field is not marked, and Simpan is disabled with no reason
findings.description: In "Catat pelanggaran" (and "Catat kunjungan") Simpan stays disabled until an Anggota is picked, but Anggota has no required mark. The sibling "Tambah aturan" dialog in the same module marks Mulai* and Berakhir*.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/violation-record-dialog.tsx:109 and visit-record-dialog.tsx:112 render `<Field label={t("member")}>` without `required`, while the submit buttons are gated on the member (violation-record-dialog.tsx:178).
findings.fix: Add `required` to the member Field in both dialogs (and to the visit member field when kind is "member").

findings.title: Switch label wraps in a narrow column inside the dialog
findings.description: In "Tambah aturan", "Peminjaman dibuka pada periode / ini" wraps onto two lines in a left column, and the switch floats in the middle of the dialog. It is out of line with the two-column fields above and below.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/library/components/loan-rules-view.tsx:279-281 uses `orientation="horizontal"`, the settings-page layout with a 14rem label column (packages/ui/src/components/field.tsx:53-58, 220-221), inside a 480px dialog.
findings.fix: Use `orientation="inline"` (label and switch on one line at every width), which also stops the phone sheet from stacking the switch under its label.

findings.title: Default this-month range shows as a user-applied filter with Reset
findings.description: On first load the page shows a tinted "Rentang tanggal: 1-17 Nov 2026" pill with an X, plus "Reset filter", which is cut at the phone's edge. Nothing has been filtered; it is the default period, but it reads as if the user narrowed the list.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-filters.tsx:128-131 treats any dateRange with from or to set as active. visits-view.tsx:48-49 always fills both with the month-to-date default.
findings.fix: Let a dateRange filter def carry its default (for example `defaultFrom` and `defaultTo`, or `isDefault`), make isFilterActive return false when the value equals it, and render that pill in the neutral, unremovable style. Pass the defaults from visits-view.tsx.

findings.title: "Keterlambatan 0" next to a member who is 33 days late
findings.description: The members table shows "Keterlambatan: 0" for Guru Contoh, whose detail page shows a book 33 days overdue. The column counts past late returns, but the label reads as the member's current lateness.
findings.cause: messages/features/library.id.json:472 `members.columns.lateReturns: "Keterlambatan"`. members-view.tsx:173-180 prints 0 as plain text.
findings.fix: Rename the label to "Riwayat terlambat" (or "Pengembalian terlambat"), show "-" for zero, and right-align the count (`meta: { align: "end" }`).

findings.title: "Orang hari ini" does not say how it differs from "Kunjungan hari ini"
findings.description: The three figures read "Kunjungan hari ini", "Anggota berbeda hari ini" and "Orang hari ini". The third, which counts group members too, is vague next to the first.
findings.cause: messages/features/library.id.json:850 `visits.summary.totalPeople: "Orang hari ini"`.
findings.fix: Use "Total pengunjung hari ini" (and "Anggota unik hari ini" for the second), with the matching English strings.

reviews.verdict: The student screens are close to the owner's bar. Izin tidak masuk opens on a hero card with a correct stepper, Izin keluar and Keterlambatan put the camera first in one consistent Scanner card, and Catatan tata tertib shows 0 poin against the SP meter even when the record is clean. Every route uses the template (eyebrow, h1, area tabs), and dark mode holds up. The staff side lets the area down. Admin, guru BK and wakasek get a leave page that is only an explainer, and its links loop through the inbox and back without showing any history. Mentoring saya shows two primary "Buat kelompok" buttons. The group member rows mix a bordered button with a ghost "Keluarkan" and sit out of line on the phone card. The guru's permit queue (where /leave-requests sends him) pushes the Setujui buttons under the tab bar. The mentoring student page is four mostly empty full-width cards with an unlabeled "30". The phone stat strip on the student leave page is cut off at the edge with no fade.
best: Student Izin tidak masuk (desktop and phone): HeroCard with the waiting stage as a chip, a stepper whose labels sit under their nodes (vertical on phone), and a clean history list with one status badge per row
Scan-first Izin keluar (satpam, admin) and Keterlambatan (siswa): one bordered Scanner card with a framed viewfinder, a stop button and a quiet 'Masukkan kode manual' fallback, the same on every role
Catatan tata tertib (siswa): hero '0 poin' with the SP 1/2/3 meter always shown and a calm success-tone empty state; the h1 now matches the menu
Buat kelompok mentoring opens as a proper bottom sheet on the phone, with a drag handle and equal-width Batal/Simpan buttons
Admin leave page in dark mode: borders, the info icon circle and the mint primary button all read correctly
worst: Staff /leave-requests is a dead end: one EmptyState pointing at notifications, and the inbox's 'Lihat riwayat izin' links straight back to it
Mentoring saya (admin): two filled 'Buat kelompok' primaries on one screen, with a search toolbar above an empty list
Group member rows: bordered 'Lihat siswa' beside a plain-text destructive 'Keluarkan', with the buttons out of line with the name on the phone card
Guru's permit queue on phone (redirect from /leave-requests): three tall 1/0/0 tiles and wrapped chips push the Setujui/Tolak buttons under the bottom bar
Student leave stat strip on phone: third cell cut in half at the card edge with no fade, and 'Sedang diproses' runs into its divider

findings.title: Staff leave page is a dead end that loops through the inbox
findings.description: For admin, guru BK and wakasek, the whole Izin tidak masuk page is one EmptyState, 'Surat izin diterbitkan dari notifikasi', with a 'Buka notifikasi' button that goes to /notifications. The page has no list and no count. The admin's empty inbox (where /late-arrivals also sends him) offers 'Lihat riwayat izin', which links back to this same page. The promised history never appears: inbox, then /leave-requests, then /notifications.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/leave-requests-view.tsx:85-99. IssuerQueueUnavailable is the entire page, and its only action links to /notifications. apps/web/features/inbox/components/action-inbox-view.tsx:20-23 and :59. HISTORY_LINKS offers /leave-requests to anyone who can open it, but only a submitter (a student) has a history there.
findings.fix: In action-inbox-view, offer the 'historyLeave' link only when useCanSubmitPermit() is true, and otherwise skip to the next link or show none. In IssuerQueueUnavailable, point the primary button at /inbox?type=leave (where approvals happen) and keep notifications as a secondary TextLink. Retitle the page around the person's job, for example 'Penerbitan surat izin', until the API offers a letter queue (see apiNeeded).

findings.title: Two primary 'Buat kelompok' buttons on Mentoring saya
findings.description: The header has a filled 'Buat kelompok' and the empty state under it has a second filled 'Buat kelompok'. On the phone both sit in the first screen, 300pt apart. Above the empty card there is also a search box with density and column icons, for a list that has no rows.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/mentoring/components/mentor-groups-view.tsx:146-157 sets the header primaryAction. Lines 206-217 give the EmptyState an identical primary Button whenever canManage is true, for both scopes. The DataTable at 173-193 keeps its toolbar while the list is empty.
findings.fix: Leave the EmptyState action undefined when canManage is true, because the header already carries the action (on the 'mine' scope, consider no create action at all). Pass searchable={items.length > 0 || search !== ''} so the toolbar disappears over an empty first-use state.

findings.title: Stat strip ends in a half-cut cell with no fade, labels touch dividers
findings.description: Under the hero card, the 'Total pengajuan / Sedang diproses / Disetujui / Ditolak' strip scrolls sideways. The third cell is cut through its icon at the card's rounded edge, and nothing hints that more cells follow. 'Sedang diproses' runs right into its divider with no right padding.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:82-92. The StatStrip scroller has no edge cue: it does not use useScrollEdges or scroll-fade-x the way the tab strips do (tab-styles.tsx:43). packages/ui/src/components/stat.tsx:75 gives the compact cell 'flex-1 min-w-36'. Every cell gets an equal share, and the explicit min-width overrides the min-content floor, so the widest label eats its pr-5.
findings.fix: In StatStrip, call useScrollEdges(scrollerRef, { axis: 'x' }) and add 'scroll-fade-x' to the scroller's classes. In ROOT_CLASS.compact, change 'flex-1' to 'flex-auto' so a cell is never narrower than its label plus padding. Alternatively, lay the strip out as a 2x2 grid below sm.

findings.title: 'Isi sebelum memindai' reason field sits after the live camera
findings.description: 'Alasan (opsional)', with the hint 'Isi sebelum memindai.', comes below the auto-started camera and the manual-entry toggle; on the phone it is at the bottom edge above the tab bar. The camera submits on its first read (continuous=false), so a student who aims first never gets to add a reason. The instruction contradicts the order on screen.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/permits/components/late-arrivals-view.tsx:111-134 passes the reason Field as the Scanner's children. Scanner renders children after the viewfinder and the manual entry (packages/ui/src/components/scanner.tsx:311-318). The copy is in apps/web/messages/id.json:1549.
findings.fix: Render the reason Field before the Scanner in the same max-w-xl column, so it is read first and the camera stays the main target. Alternatively, keep scan-first and let the student add the reason on the ActiveLateArrival hero after the scan, and delete the 'Isi sebelum memindai' hint.

findings.title: Member rows mix button styles; destructive 'Keluarkan' is plain text
findings.description: Each member row has a bordered 'Lihat siswa' with an icon next to a borderless black 'Keluarkan'. The destructive action looks like a label, and the two buttons in one row have different styles. On the phone card both buttons hang about 10pt above the name 'Siswa Contoh', so the row is out of line. The group list one level up uses a row tap plus a '...' RowActionsMenu with a danger tone for delete.
