baseline.note: Each route now renders its own screen and h1 (Izin tidak masuk / Izin keluar / Keterlambatan) under the 'Izin dan keterlambatan' eyebrow, with underline area tabs; the type Select is gone.

The in-progress permit is now a hero on the page (code), and history rows carry an icon, date, time and one status badge, so 'Selesai' plus 'Kedaluwarsa' no longer contradict each other. Rows still show only the date and time, with no destination or time window, which needs the API.

The camera now comes first in a proper Scanner card, with a typed code behind a toggle. The optional reason now sits after the live camera while its hint says to fill it in before scanning (see kesiswaan-2-04).
The phone first screen now leads with the title, 'Ajukan izin' and the hero card with its stepper, and the counts are a low strip. The strip itself clips its third cell (see kesiswaan-2-03).
The half-applied kiosk sizing is gone; every scan screen uses the action-variant Scanner card on the page type scale, with a framed viewfinder.
The hero stepper places 'Wali kelas' and 'Guru BK' under their nodes on desktop and as a vertical list on the phone, using the shared Stepper.
Completed stages now show their time (code: stageTimes). Who approved still needs an actor display name from the API, and pending stages show only 'Ditinjau langsung'.

The bare alert became a proper EmptyState with a button, but guru BK, wakasek and admin still have no queue or history. The button goes to /notifications rather than the inbox, and the inbox's 'Lihat riwayat izin' loops back (see kesiswaan-2-01).

Exit, leave, discipline and mentoring now use the shared EmptyState with actions. The gate log's 'Belum ada siswa yang lewat gerbang' is still a bare paragraph, and the meeting-notes empty body still says 'Klik baris untuk membuka isinya' (mentoring.id.json:95).
Mentoring pages have one header followed by the area underline tabs; the extra scope tab row is replaced by two routes, and group detail uses one pill tab set for its own sections.
The screens now say 'Kelompok mentoring', 'Mentoring saya' and 'Catatan tata tertib', in sentence case and matching the menu; no Title Case labels are left in these routes.
The hero shows '0 poin' with the SP meter even when the record is clean, and the h1 'Catatan tata tertib' matches the menu. The meter repeats its level names (see kesiswaan-2-13).
No form was captured in this unit. The code uses DateRangePicker in leave-request-submit-form.tsx:149 and the shared DateTimeField for mentoring notes.
The scope tabs without panels are gone; mine and all are separate routes (/mentoring/my-groups, /mentoring/groups) reached through the area tabs.
The Keterlambatan entry is now offered to students only (lib/navigation.ts:455, offeredTo profileKinds student). Staff reach the inbox redirect only through old links.
The admin no longer gets the student submit UI; he gets the gate and approve desk on Izin keluar and the issuer explainer on Izin tidak masuk (itself a dead end, see kesiswaan-2-01).

apiNeeded: Letter issuers and admin need a list of leave requests awaiting a letter, plus a leave history: /v1/leave-requests/review-queue requires review_leave_requests, and there is no list-all endpoint.
GET /v1/exit-permits returns bare WorkflowInstances; the history rows need destination and the time window to say where and when.
WorkflowEvent carries only actor_user_id; the Stepper needs a display name to show who approved each stage.
Permit and scan codes are UUIDs or 43-character tokens; the teacher's 'Kode izin siswa' field on a phone needs a short human-readable code.
The guru role lacks view_mentoring, so the seeded mentor (Guru Contoh) gets 403 on /mentoring/my-groups although he leads 'Kelompok bimbingan X-A'.

reviews.verdict: Data sekolah now looks like one product. Every route uses AppPage (eyebrow, one h1, underline area tabs), panels are Cards, every dialog becomes a bottom sheet with a sticky Simpan on a phone, and dark mode holds up. The main screens are well composed: the student profile went from a page dominated by empty states to a real detail page (trail, avatar header, stat tiles, one-line risk status, biodata); the calendar has today, a legend, a day panel and a reader sheet; classes and both import screens are now clean and consistent with each other. It stays below 8 because of visible unevenness. The user list cuts its ninth row mid-text at the fold with no fade. On a phone the student header stacks two buttons of different widths, and on desktop it mixes button sizes in one row. Sibling hubs disagree on where the add button sits, how rows are edited and whether the page has a description, so the tab strip jumps when you switch tabs. Copy still slips: the tab says "Kelas dan siswa" under the title "Siswa dan kelas", the time zone shows "Asia/Makassar", and one help text says "dianggap error". In the captured build /school/classes also threw an uncaught Worker error on every load. The fix (4bb63ec3) is on the branch tip but not in 4c5005fe.
best: Student profile: breadcrumb through the class, 64px avatar header, four stat tiles, a one-line 'Tidak ada tanda risiko' strip and biodata as a DataList, a large step up from the old page of empty states
Calendar: shared Calendar with today marked, kind legend, a selected-day card, reader-specific empty copy, and an add form with DateRangePicker that becomes a bottom sheet on a phone
Siswa dan kelas: class List plus one detail Card with a capacity badge, a roster DataTable with selection, and a class Select on a phone, so nothing spills at 390px
User import and enrollment import share one shape (Stepper, one prepare card, FileDropzone), which fixes the two divergent imports of the old version
Every create or edit dialog in the area is a bottom sheet with a sticky Batal/Simpan footer on a phone and a tidy centred dialog on desktop
Setup: HeroCard with a progress meter and 'Siap dipakai' chip, checklist as a List with check circles
worst: Pengguna dan akses desktop: the ninth row is cut mid-text at the bottom of the table card with no scroll fade
Student profile on a phone: 'Cetak laporan' and 'Catat tindak lanjut konseling' stack left-aligned at different widths; on desktop 'Cetak laporan' is smaller than its neighbours

Hubs disagree with each other: 'Tambah' sits in the header on some pages and in the table toolbar on others, rows are edited through '...' menus on some pages and pencil and bin icons on others, and the tab strip shifts vertically between sibling tabs

Copy: the tab 'Kelas dan siswa' sits under the title 'Siswa dan kelas', the tab 'Persiapan tahun ajaran baru' sits under the title 'Tahun ajaran baru' and is cut on a phone, the time zone shows raw 'Asia/Makassar', and one help text says 'dianggap error'

findings.title: Uncaught DataCloneError from the service-worker nav cache on every class page load
findings.description: Every capture of /school/classes (admin, pustakawan, satpam; desktop and phone; light and dark) recorded the uncaught page error "Failed to execute 'postMessage' on 'Worker': URL object could not be cloned." It does not show in the image, but it fires on every visit and on every class switch. It also breaks serwist's navigation cache for that history entry, so the page is not cached for offline use.
findings.cause: apps/web/next.config.ts:26 enables @serwist/next `cacheOnNavigation: true`, which wraps history.pushState/replaceState and posts the URL argument to its nav-cache Worker. At the reviewed head 4c5005fe, apps/web/lib/hooks/use-url-state.ts (write(), the history call at line 45) passed the URL object, not a string. apps/web/features/school/components/classes-view.tsx:51 calls replaceSelectedId(selected.id) in a mount effect, so every load writes ?class= through that path and throws. The same bug exists in apps/web/lib/hooks/use-quick-action.ts:26 and apps/web/features/library/use-opac-search-params.ts:67. Nothing in the feature creates a Worker itself; the Worker belongs to serwist.
findings.fix: Pass url.href, a string, to every history.pushState/replaceState call. This is already committed as 4bb63ec3 ('fix(web): hand the history API a string URL'), which is in the branch tip 445fbb05 but not in 4c5005fe. In the fix round, confirm that commit is in the build and recapture /school/classes with pageErrors empty. To stop a regression, route all history writes through one helper in apps/web/lib (for example writeHistoryUrl(href: string, replace: boolean)) and keep the existing use-url-state test.
alsoOn: any route that writes URL state through useUrlState (tabs and filters on /school/users, /school/structure, /school/calendar)

reviews.verdict: It mostly reads as one product. The shell, the page header type, the underline area tabs, the DataTable chrome, the cards and radii, the empty-state block and above all the dialogs (title, close, labels above 36px fields, Batal + Simpan bottom right) match in every area. Dark mode is the strongest part. The tokens were clearly designed for it rather than inverted: there is no vanishing text, no light panel left behind, status and category colours keep their meaning without glare, focus rings show, and the sidebar, header, sheets and tab bar all hold up. What lets the product down is structural drift between areas, and a user feels it the moment they switch tabs. Within one tab strip the page column jumps between 720px centred and full width, so the settings sections and Presensi saya vs Presensi pegawai move sideways. Some areas put the area name in the h1 and others the active tab's name, with eyebrows to match. The add action sits in the header in some places and in the table toolbar in others. Row actions come four ways. Empty lists show two identical solid primaries. A raw key, "reports", shows as a tab label. Strongest area: Kepegawaian and Piket (Buku tamu, Supervisi): one h1 across all tabs, the primary always in the header, kebab row actions, consistent stat strips. Weakest area: Pengaturan sekolah, where tabs of one section switch between narrow centred, full-width and half-width layouts. Kesiswaan is a close second, with its h1 changing per tab, an eyebrow that disagrees with its sibling tab, squashed stat tiles, a raw ISO date and text-button row actions.
best: Dialogs are uniform everywhere (19 compared): same title row, close icon, label-above fields, Batal then Simpan bottom right, bottom sheet on the phone

Dark mode tokens (packages/ui-tokens/tokens.json) give real dark surfaces, readable muted text, desaturated category colours and a mint accent with dark text; no light leftovers on about 80 dark screens
Shell: sidebar with group rail and flyout, header search, account menu, command palette and the phone tab bar with its raised centre all look finished in both themes
DataTable chrome (search 320px, filter pills, density and column icons, header row, '4 data' footer) is identical across Data sekolah, Perpustakaan, Kepegawaian and Kesiswaan
Buku tamu and Supervisi keep one h1 across their tabs, put the primary in the header and use kebab row actions; these are the template done right
Sign-in, OPAC and verify pages are polished in both themes
worst: Settings tab groups and Presensi saya vs Presensi pegawai jump between a 720px centred column and a full-width one, so the title and tabs slide about 216px when you switch tabs
No single h1 convention: area name vs active-tab name vs a mix, and the eyebrow of Peringatan dini disagrees with its sibling tab Catatan konseling
Empty lists show two identical solid primaries (header plus empty state), desktop and phone
Raw key 'reports' as the first tab on /library/reports
Add action and row actions built four ways (header vs toolbar; kebab vs pencil and trash vs text buttons vs a filled primary in a row)
Horizontal scrollers without the shared edge fade: the home stat strip on the phone and the mobile menu 'Terakhir dibuka' chips cut off at the screen edge

findings.title: Page column jumps between 720px centred and full width across tabs of one area
findings.description: Within one tab strip the header, the tabs and the content move about 216px sideways. Notifikasi bawaan is narrow and centred (title at x=480); WhatsApp and Integrasi are full width at x=264, with the WhatsApp form taking only the left half. Sesi dan masuk and Masuk dengan Google are centred, Jejak audit is full width. Templat dokumen is centred, Merek sekolah and Kop laporan are full width. Presensi saya (/check-in) is centred while its tab sibling Presensi pegawai is full width. Notifikasi, Profil, Pindai and Operasi massal are also centred, while their neighbours in the sidebar are not.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:107-112 centres the whole column (`mx-auto` plus `max-w-narrow`) for the narrow variant, head included. features/settings/components/settings-page.tsx:35 defaults every settings page to narrow. branding-view, report-header-view, integrations-view and whatsapp-settings-view pass `variant="default"`, audit-logs-view passes `fit`, and staff-attendance/components/self-check-in-view.tsx uses narrow under the same StaffAttendanceWorkspaceNav as the default-width staff board.
findings.fix: Keep the head (breadcrumb, header, tabs) at the shared width and left edge for every variant. Apply `max-w-narrow` only to `[data-slot=page-body]`, left-aligned, so a narrow page only shortens its content line and never moves its title or tabs. Failing that, pick one variant per tab group (settings sections all `default`, check-in `default`).

findings.title: h1 and eyebrow follow three different conventions, so the title repeats the tab and changes per tab
findings.description: Most areas keep the area name as the h1 with the sub-pages as tabs: Presensi dan jurnal, Jadwal dan kalender, Pengguna dan akses, Buku tamu, Pembelajaran, Struktur sekolah. Kesiswaan and parts of Data sekolah instead make the h1 the active tab, with the area as eyebrow: 'Izin tidak masuk' sits above an 'Izin tidak masuk' tab, and the same happens with Pelanggaran, Prestasi, Ekstrakurikuler, Agenda kegiatan, Tahun ajaran, Tahun ajaran baru, Kenaikan kelas and Impor penempatan kelas. Peringatan dini mixes the two: its eyebrow says 'Kesiswaan' while its sibling tab Catatan konseling says 'Konseling BK'. Because title, eyebrow and description change from tab to tab (Jurnal mengajar adds 'Belum ada jurnal minggu ini' as a description), the tab strip itself jumps up and down.
findings.cause: AppPage derives h1 = area entry label and eyebrow = sidebar group (apps/web/components/app-page.tsx:122,132-135), but many views override them: discipline/components/violations-view.tsx:54-55, warning-letters-view.tsx, discipline/components/counseling-view.tsx:117-118, permits/components/leave-requests-view.tsx:39-40, permits/components/late-arrivals-view.tsx, activities/components/achievements-view.tsx, clubs-view.tsx and activities-calendar-view.tsx (title plus eyebrow), mentoring/components/mentor-groups-view.tsx, academic/components/years-view.tsx, new-year-setup-view.tsx and enrollment-import-view.tsx, promotion/components/promotion-view.tsx. analytics/components/at-risk-students-view.tsx:174 overrides the title but not the eyebrow. journal/components/journal-view.tsx:222 adds a per-tab description.
findings.fix: Use one rule, the template's: on area pages with tabs, do not pass `title` or `eyebrow`, so the h1 is the area entry label and the eyebrow is the sidebar group. Give the activities workspace a `label` in lib/navigation-workspaces.ts so its h1 reads 'Kegiatan siswa'. Move per-tab status lines (journal week summary, attendance helper) into the content or toolbar so the head is identical on every tab.

findings.title: Two identical solid primaries in view when a list is empty
findings.description: The header carries 'Catat pelanggaran' and the empty state directly below carries the same solid 'Catat pelanggaran'. On a phone both are full-colour pills on one screen. The same pairing appears on Jurnal baru, Catat prestasi, Tambah kegiatan, Catat konseling, Catat insiden, Minta pengganti, Buat kelompok, Tambah aturan, the library's Catat pelanggaran, and others.

findings.title: Create action and row actions are built four different ways
findings.description: Pengguna dan akses, Siswa dan kelas, Tahun ajaran, Supervisi, Katalog and Kelompok mentoring put 'Tambah ...' in the page header and use a kebab menu per row. Their own siblings Pembelajaran (Mata pelajaran, Jam pelajaran) and Struktur sekolah (Tingkat kelas, Peminatan, Ruang) put the add button in the table toolbar and show bare pencil and trash icons on every row. Ekstrakurikuler uses 'Ubah' and 'Hapus' text buttons. Kelompok bimbingan uses 'Lihat siswa' and 'Keluarkan' buttons. Stok opname puts a filled primary 'Lanjutkan pindai' in the row, a second primary next to 'Mulai sesi baru'.
findings.cause: school/components/subjects-view.tsx:87-136, academic/components/grade-levels-view.tsx:121-163 (same in tracks-view, rooms-view, subject-offerings-view, school/components/periods-view and period-table): `toolbarActions` plus inline IconButtons. activities/components/clubs-view.tsx:127-146: text Buttons. mentoring/components/mentor-group-members-panel.tsx: text Buttons. library/components/stocktake-view.tsx:90: `variant="primary"` in a row.
findings.fix: Use one pattern: the create action goes to AppPage `primaryAction` (per tab), and edit, delete and remove go in `RowActionsMenu`, the kebab already used in 32 views. A row's single main verb, if any, is a `secondary` size-sm button, never primary.

findings.title: Horizontal scrollers end in a cut item with no fade (home stat strip, menu recents)
findings.description: On the phone home (admin, guru and siswa, both themes), the stat strip shows two figures. The third begins as a divider sliver at the right edge with nothing to say it scrolls, and 'Menunggu tinjauan' and 'Izin kelas menunggu' run into that divider. The figures' baselines are also ragged, because a two-line hint ('dari 1 sesi hari ini') pushes one number up. In the mobile menu, the 'Terakhir dibuka' chips run off the sheet edge mid-word ('Pengguna d') with no fade, and the chips are 36px tall.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/stat-grid.tsx:89 is a plain `overflow-x-auto` scroller with no `scroll-fade-x`, no `useScrollEdges` and no trailing padding. packages/ui/src/components/stat.tsx:75 sets compact stats to `justify-center`. apps/web/components/mobile-menu.tsx:157 is a `overflow-x-auto` list without the fade.
findings.fix: Use the shared `scroll-fade-x` utility with `useScrollEdges` (as tab-styles.tsx:43 does) on both scrollers, and add `pr-4` so the last item clears the edge. Top-align compact stats (`justify-start`) so values share a baseline. Give the recents chips `h-11` touch height.

findings.title: Empty progress tracks and wells render as near-black bars in dark mode
findings.description: In dark mode the empty 'Presensi kelas yang sedang belajar 0/1' track in the green hero is a solid #121110 bar, the heaviest shape in the card. In light it is a pale track. The same black bar appears in the attendance summary card, and the same token makes the mobile menu search and the segmented-control tracks in the notification popover and roles panel read as black holes on raised surfaces.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/progress.tsx:145 paints the track `bg-surface-sunken`. In tokens.json the dark surfaceSunken is #121110, darker than the page (#171613), so any well on a raised or tinted surface (#211F1B card, #16352C hero, #282621 sheet) becomes near-black.
findings.fix: Paint Progress tracks with `bg-neutral-soft` (rgba of fg at 9% in both themes), so the track is always one step from its parent. Optionally make the dark `surfaceSunken` token translucent (e.g. rgba(0,0,0,0.25)) so every well sits one step below whatever it is on.

reviews.verdict: Mostly yes. Motion is the strongest part of the overhaul. Every transition and animation I measured live uses the token set (80, 120, 160, 200 and 320 ms on the four curves). There is no transition-all and no bounce, and only opacity and transform move, apart from the two layout cases the spec allows. Dialogs, phone bottom sheets, popovers, toasts, the tab-bar pill, the segmented pill, the tab underline and the sidebar marker all move quietly and on time. The phone's 20px forward and back slides, the quick tab fade and the header title swap feel like a native app, and reduced motion removes every transform: the pill jumps, sheets fade in 120 ms and the press scale stays at 1. Five things let it down. The home replays a five-step entrance on every visit when the spec says once: a skeleton flash, the hero rising, the tiles and cards staggering, then the numbers counting up. On the library settings page the section tabs change the URL but never the page. Phone filter pickers open as desktop popovers that cover the raised centre button. A passkey row pops into the sign-in card after the page loads. Area-tab underlines jump instead of sliding, because each tab is its own route. Two motions are missing from the written motion rules: the directional phone page slide should be added to them, and the 18 s login orb loop should be removed or written in as an exception.
best: One motion vocabulary used everywhere: all logged transitions and animations are 80/120/160/200/320 ms on ease-standard, enter, exit and sheet; no transition-all; no raw durations in components

Overlays are clean: dialog fades and scales from 0.97 (200 ms in, 120 ms out), the phone bottom sheet and Menu slide in 320 ms on ease-sheet and out in 200 ms, popovers and menus shift 4px in 160/120 ms, toasts take 200/120 ms

Indicators move by transform only: the tab-bar pill slides 200 ms between tabs and fades out for the centre action, the segmented pill and the Tabs underline FLIP in 200 ms, the sidebar marker glides 200 ms
Phone navigation feels native: forward and back slide the page column 20px with a fade in 200 ms, the bottom tabs fade in 120 ms, and the header swaps in the page title in 200 ms on scroll
Reduced motion really works: no transforms at all, the pill and the sidebar width jump, sheets and dialogs only fade in 120 ms, the press scale stays at 1, the home stagger delays drop to 0
Press feedback is everywhere it should be: buttons scale to 0.98 in 80 ms and settle in 120 ms, bottom tabs to 0.96, rows and list rows show a 120 ms hover layer
worst: Library settings section tabs do nothing: the URL changes to ?section=memberTypes, but the view and the active tab stay on Aturan peminjaman
The home replays a five-step entrance with a skeleton flash, staggers and count-up on every visit, on top of the page's own entrance
On a phone, DataTable filter options open as an anchored desktop popover that runs down to and covers the raised centre button
The sign-in card grows 30-45px when the passkey option pops in after the page loads, mid-entrance
Area tab underlines jump to the new tab instead of sliding, because each tab remounts the page

coverage.route: motion:hover (table rows, list rows, stat cells)
motion:skeleton-to-content (cold route, tbody and cards fade)

findings.title: Library settings section tabs change the URL but not the page
findings.description: Clicking Jenis anggota or Data katalog under Pengaturan perpustakaan changes the address to ?section=memberTypes, but the underline, the browser tab title and the body all stay on Aturan peminjaman. They were still unchanged 6 s later. The only feedback is the tab's hover background. Loading the same URL directly shows the right section, so the tabs only fail on client-side navigation. The RSC request returns 200 in under 10 ms, and nothing re-renders afterwards.
findings.cause: apps/web/lib/hooks/use-url-state.ts:14-15 reads window.location.search during render on the client instead of the router's searchParams. On a <Link> navigation, Next.js renders the new tree before it pushes the history entry, so that render reads the old ?section=loanRules. Nothing triggers another render once the URL updates. apps/web/features/library/components/library-settings-view.tsx:46-50 takes the section from this hook, and its NavTabs at :71-80 are plain Link hrefs.
findings.fix: In use-url-state.ts, read the params from useSearchParams() on the client too (`const currentParams = searchParams;`) and drop the popstate refresh. Next 15 keeps useSearchParams in sync with window.history.pushState, so the hook's own write() keeps working. A narrower fix is to read `useSearchParams().get("section")` in LibrarySettingsView, the way school-structure-view.tsx:36 does.
alsoOn: /library/reports?tab=... reached from links in library-workspace-nav.tsx:115 (same cause, not checked live)

findings.title: Home replays a five-step entrance on every visit
findings.description: Going back to Beranda with its data already cached goes through these frames after the click (desktop): the content area is blank at 100-117 ms; only the greeting shows at 136 ms; the home skeleton flashes at 150-167 ms; the side column is real but the main column empty at 184 ms; the hero rises 8px at 197-300 ms; the stat tiles rise 40 ms later; the 'Terlambat' tile counts 0, 1, 2 until about 330 ms. Tapping the Beranda tab on a phone plays the same sequence (sheet-ph-tab-home.png). It is the busiest motion in the app and it sits on the most visited page. The spec allows the stagger and the count-up only on the first load.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-view.tsx:240-270 and :318-322 give the hero, the StatGrid and every main card animate-enter with --stagger (stagger() at :74-76) on every mount, inside AppPage, whose page-content already plays animate-enter (packages/ui/src/components/page-shell.tsx:139). The two entrances therefore play one after the other. The inline HomeSkeleton (:241) shows with no delay whenever collected.pending is briefly true. HomeStat passes countUp (:368), and use-count-up.ts:56 keeps hasCounted per mount, so the numbers count again on every visit.
findings.fix: Add a module-level `let homeEntered = false` in dashboard-view.tsx. Render the stagger classes and countUp only while it is false, then set it to true in an effect after the first non-pending render. Later visits then get only PageShell's single 200 ms content entrance. Give the inline HomeSkeleton the same delayed fade as app/(app)/loading.tsx (`animate-fade-in [animation-delay:var(--duration-base)]`) so a short pending state never flashes. Skip the count-up for values under 10: counting to 2 shows a wrong '1' for about 100 ms.

findings.title: Phone filter options open as a desktop popover over the centre button
findings.description: At 390px, tapping the Status filter pill opens an anchored 224px popover (popover-in, 160 ms) instead of a bottom sheet. Its ten options run down to the tab bar, and the bottom edge covers the top of the raised Sirkulasi centre button (ph-filter-zoom.png). Every other picker on the phone (dialogs, Menu) slides up as a sheet, so this one feels like a desktop control.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-filters.tsx:269-304 (single choice) and :393-469 (multiple choice) render PopoverContent at every width. packages/ui/src/components/popover.tsx:20 uses collisionPadding 8, which knows nothing about --shell-mobile-tab-offset.
findings.fix: Below 640px, render the same option list in the shared Sheet (side="bottom"), which already slides in 320 ms, has a grab handle and can be dragged closed. One way is a small ResponsivePopover in packages/ui that switches on usePhoneLayout(), which toast.tsx already uses. At minimum, pass collisionPadding={{ top: 8, left: 8, right: 8, bottom: tabBarOffsetPx + 8 }} so the list stays clear of the bar and its centre button.

findings.title: Sign-in card jumps when the passkey option appears after loading
findings.description: The divider ('atau') and 'Masuk dengan passkey' appear only after the page loads in the browser: between 132 and 149 ms on desktop and between 182 and 199 ms on the phone. Their arrival pushes the 'Belum punya akun' note down about 45px on the phone, while the card is still playing its entrance. Sign-in is the first screen every user sees, so the card visibly grows.
findings.cause: apps/web/features/auth/components/login-form.tsx:93 shows the alternatives only when usePasskeySupported() is true. In apps/web/lib/webauthn.ts:51-53 that hook's server snapshot returns false, so the server render and the first client render leave the block out, and it pops in on the next client render.
findings.fix: Make the server snapshot optimistic (`() => true`), so the block is in the first paint and only disappears in the rare browser without WebAuthn. Keep the button disabled until the page has loaded, like the Masuk button. Alternatively, keep the row's height reserved and fade the block in with animate-fade-in.

findings.title: Area tab underline jumps instead of sliding
findings.description: Switching Katalog to Eksemplar moves the underline indicator from 0 to 77px in one frame at about 133 ms, with no translate transition logged. Spec 4.5 promises a 200 ms slide, and in-page Tabs (member detail) and SegmentedControl (desk) do slide. Area tabs, the most common tabs in the app, never do.
findings.cause: apps/web/components/app-page.tsx:145-160 builds the NavTabs inside each page, so a sibling route mounts a fresh strip. packages/ui/src/hooks/use-active-indicator.ts:114-128 only travels when the same instance has a `previous` box, so the first placement on the new page is instant.
findings.fix: In use-active-indicator.ts, remember the last placed box in a module-level Map keyed by the strip's accessible name; AppPage already builds the nav aria-label from the area name. On first placement, when the remembered box differs, take the same FLIP path as `moved`: write the old box, settle, then write the new one. Alternatively, render area NavTabs from a per-area layout so the strip persists across routes.

findings.title: Phone tab switch blinks to an empty page for two frames
findings.description: On a bottom-tab switch the old page disappears as soon as the new one takes over, and the new column fades in from opacity 0. Frames at 160 and 177 ms (Katalog) and 127 and 144 ms (Beranda) show only the header and the tab bar over the empty background. A native tab bar swaps without a blink.
findings.cause: apps/web/app/globals.css:213-215: html[data-nav-direction="tab"] runs `fade-in` (opacity from 0) over 120 ms on the page column.
findings.fix: Give tab switches their own keyframe that starts part-way, for example `@keyframes page-enter-tab { from { opacity: .5 } }`, at the same 120 ms. Or drop the fade for tab switches entirely and let the moving pill carry the change.

findings.title: Sign-in background loops forever, outside the written motion rules
findings.description: The glow behind the sign-in brand panel drifts and grows to 1.15 scale on an 18 s ease-in-out loop that never stops. The motion spec allows no loop except the skeleton, spinners and the live dot, and no motion longer than 320 ms. It is subtle and reduced motion stops it, but it is the only ambient animation in the product and it is not documented.
findings.cause: apps/web/app/globals.css:121-138 defines `.auth-orb-a { animation: auth-orb-a 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate }` with a raw easing. apps/web/features/auth/components/auth-brand-panel.tsx:44 applies it.
findings.fix: Remove the animation and keep the static glow, or write it into section 4 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-14-ui-overhaul-design.md and docs/07-ui-ux.md as the single ambient exception. At the same time, document the phone's 20px forward and back page slide (globals.css:181-223), which is good but also missing from the spec.

findings.title: Tappable phone list cards only change colour on press
findings.description: On a phone, a DataTable card that opens its record on tap only shows the pressed colour layer. Buttons, interactive Card, Stat tiles and the bottom tabs all shrink to 0.98 or 0.96 when pressed, and spec 4.2 names clickable cards explicitly. The cards are the most-tapped surface on the phone list pages, so they feel slightly dead next to everything else. Found by reading the code; the emulated touch could not hold a press to measure it.
findings.cause: packages/ui/src/components/data-table/data-table-cards.tsx:168-172: the li has only transition-colors. The full-card overlay button at :263-269 adds `hover:bg-state-hover active:bg-state-pressed` but no scale.
findings.fix: On the li, add `transition-[background-color,border-color,box-shadow,scale] has-[>button:active]:scale-(--motion-scale-press) has-[>button:active]:duration-instant`. Reduced motion already sets --motion-scale-press to 1.
